profile.description: ThirstyFest is a volunteer-led craft beer fundraiser benefiting Water For People. Adult/21+ status is not a disqualifier for Adventure Zone. After review, this event is a poor operational/commercial fit because the known format is a short-duration beer-tasting fundraiser centered on beverages, food trucks, music and lawn games, without a natural need for a large staffed attraction package.

notes.subject: 2026 review — non-fit based on event format
notes.body: Adventure Zone emailed ThirstyFest in 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. Adult/21+ and beer-focused events remain eligible in general, but ThirstyFest itself is not a strong fit: the known event format is a short volunteer-led craft beer fundraiser with tastings, food trucks, music and lawn games. A full staffed Adventure Zone or Warrior's Playground setup would be disproportionate to the event format and operating window. Do not create routine outreach unless the event materially changes format.
